name: Making Our Skin
overview: Scripture reveals that God intentionally created humanity with skin as part of His design, clothing Adam and Eve with coats of skin after the fall, demonstrating His provision and care (Genesis 1:26; 3:21). The skin not only serves as a physical covering but also reflects the reality of human frailty and sin, as seen in the leprous hand of Moses and the detailed priestly examination of skin diseases (Exodus 4:6; Leviticus 13:2-3). Job acknowledges that God has intricately formed him with skin, flesh, bones, and sinews, underscoring the divine craftsmanship in our very bodies (Job 10:11).
